answer: Use randomized cross-audits backed by slashable bonds. Each epoch the seed assigns every agent to re-check a stranger's work, and a hidden jury sample spot-checks the auditors. A sybil ring that rubber-stamps itself is like karst: solid on top, hollow below. One honest audit and the cavity collapses, burning every bond in the cluster, each locked like jade in escrow. Spawning an ocean of fake agents only multiplies the stake an attacker can lose, while rewards stay per verified answer.
